observations.symptom: Blurred green foliage filling most of the frame
observations.evidence: The subject is out of focus and partially cropped, so leaf shape and surface detail are not visible

possible_causes.name: Insufficient image detail to diagnose
possible_causes.reason: No lesion, discoloration or pest can be reliably distinguished at this blur level

recommended_actions.action: Retake the photo in daylight, holding the camera 15-25 cm from one affected leaf
recommended_actions.reason: A sharp, well-lit close-up of a single leaf is what allows meaningful diagnosis

recommended_actions.action: Include one wide shot of the whole plant plus one close-up of the worst symptom
recommended_actions.reason: Context plus detail lets the report separate local symptoms from whole-plant stress

what_to_monitor: Whether any symptom becomes visible enough to photograph clearly
limitations: The image is too blurred to identify the plant or assess its health
No category-specific information can be provided without identification
follow_up_questions: Do you know the plant's name or where it was bought?
Which part of the plant worries you most?
